what: Download and unpack supplementary IDAT files
title: Real-World QC and Imprinting Analysis: GSE240091 Dataset
code: raw_dir <- file.path("GSE240091_raw") dir.create(raw_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)  # Downloads GSE240091_RAW.tar from GEO. supp <- GEOquery::getGEOSuppFiles(geo_gse, makeDirectory = TRUE, baseDir = raw_dir) print(supp)  tar_file <- rownames(supp)[grepl("RAW\\.tar$", rownames(supp))] untar(tar_file, exdir = file.path(raw_dir, geo_gse))  # GEO IDAT archives are commonly gzipped inside the tar. gz_idats <- list.files(   file.path(raw_dir, geo_gse),   pattern = "\\.idat\\.gz$",   recursive = TRUE,   full.names = TRUE ) if (length(gz_idats) > 0 && requireNamespace("R.utils", quietly = TRUE)) {   lapply(gz_idats, R.utils::gunzip, overwrite = TRUE, remove = TRUE) }  # minfi expects channel suffixes named _Red.idat and _Grn.idat. # GSE240091 raw files may unpack as lowercase _red.idat and _green.idat. lowercase_idats <- list.files(   file.path(raw_dir, geo_gse),   pattern = "_(red|green)\\.idat$",   recursive = TRUE,   full.names = TRUE )  for (old_file in lowercase_idats) {   new_file <- sub("_red\\.idat$", "_Red.idat", old_file)   new_file <- sub("_green\\.idat$", "_Grn.idat", new_file)   if (!identical(old_file, new_file)) {     file.rename(old_file, new_file)   } }

code: idat_files <- list.files(   file.path(raw_dir, geo_gse),   pattern = "_(Red|Grn)\\.idat$",   recursive = TRUE,   full.names = TRUE )  # idat_prefixes <- unique(sub("_(red|green)\\.idat(\\.gz)?$", "", idat_files)) idat_prefixes <- unique(sub("_(Red|Grn)\\.idat$", "", idat_files)) idat_base <- basename(idat_prefixes) idat_map <- data.frame(   Basename = idat_prefixes,   GEO_Accession = sub("_.*$", "", idat_base),   IDAT_Sample_Title = sub("^GSM[0-9]+_?", "", idat_base),   stringsAsFactors = FALSE )  # GEO raw files usually start with GSM accessions. Join by GSM first and keep # the title-derived name as a readable sample label for QC reports. meta_qc <- meta %>%   left_join(idat_map, by = "GEO_Accession") %>%   mutate(     Sample_Name = paste(GEO_Accession, "_", IDAT_Sample_Title),     Sample_Group = Sample_Group,     Platform = "EPIC"   )  meta_qc <- meta_qc[, c("Sample_Name", "Sample_Group", "Platform", "Basename")] head(meta_qc)

title: ImprintomeSet Workflow Quickstart
text: RAW data: Load metadata. meta.tsv must tab-delimited file least Sample_Name Sample_Group columns. QC workflow (raw IDAT files): also include Basename column (IDAT file path prefixes, e.g. /path//idats/SentrixID_SentrixPosition). direct analysis (QC already done): Basename needed. platform unknown mixed, detect first: platform already known, pass directly: Inspect QC results: Visualize QC metrics: Export cleaned data: already QC-cleaned data: Skip MethQcSet load pre-cleaned beta values. Note: Basename column needed since QC already done. Optional: Merge multiple QC-approved single-platform datasets:
code: meta <- LoadMeta("meta.tsv") # Reads one IDAT per sample, infers platform from probe count # Appends Platform, Array_Size, Manifest, Status columns to meta meta <- check_platform(meta) table(meta$Platform)  # inspect; split if multiple platforms present  # Run QC for one platform at a time meta_epic <- meta[meta$Platform == "EPIC", ] qcset <- runMethQC(meta_epic)  # platform auto-resolved from meta$Platform # runMethQC() loads IDAT files, extracts beta + detection p-values, and runs QC qcset <- runMethQC(meta, platform = "EPIC") qc_summary <- qc_summarize(qcset) qc_summary$platform qc_summary$n_samples qc_summary$n_probes qc_summary$aggregation_status # PASS / FAIL sample count bar chart (default) p_bar <- plot(qcset, type = "qc_bar")  # Methylated vs unmethylated intensity scatter, cutoff line at log2 = 11 p_int <- plot(qcset, type = "intensity", icutoff = 11,               outFile = "qc_intensity.pdf")  # Average detection p-value per sample, cutoff line at 0.05 p_dp  <- plot(qcset, type = "detection_pval", pcutoff = 0.05)  # % probes detected per sample, reference line at 95% p_cov <- plot(qcset, type = "probe_coverage")  # Predicted sex distribution p_sex <- plot(qcset, type = "predicted_sex")  # control probe metrics — summary (NULL if these metrics could not be computed) p_ctrl <- plot(qcset, type = "ctrl_metrics")  # Per-metric detail plots (Bisulfite Conversion, Specificity, Non-polymorphic) # outFile is used as a path prefix; one PDF is saved per control metric plot(qcset, type = "ctrl_metrics_detail",      outFile = "qc_ctrl_matrix_detail") dir.create("qc_output", showWarnings = FALSE)  exported_files <- export(   qcset,   outdir = "qc_output",   format = c("xlsx", "rds") ) # Creates two Excel workbooks: #   qc_table_main.xlsx: metadata, QC_matrix, Ctrl_matrix (control probes), statistics #   qc_table_extra.xlsx: QC_metrics (thresholds), recall_rate (if available), #                         contamination and predUniqDonor_ID (SNP probes) # Plus: qcset.rds (full MethQcSet object) # Plus: qcset_summary.txt (summary report with Notes section documenting missing sheets) meta <- LoadMeta("meta.tsv")  # Only needs Sample_Name and Sample_Group beta <- LoadBeta("cleaned_beta.tsv")  # Already QC-approved  # Proceed to Section 2: Create ImprintomeSet # Two separate MethQcSet objects (same platform) qcset1 <- MethQcSet(meta1, beta1, platform = "EPICv1") qcset2 <- MethQcSet(meta2, beta2, platform = "EPICv1")  # Synchronized merge (common samples/probes) merged <- merge(qcset1, qcset2, how = "inner")  # Find common elements across objects common_samples <- find_intersection(qcset1, qcset2, by = "samples") common_probes <- find_intersection(qcset1, qcset2, by = "probes")

code: # Load metadata: tab-delimited with at least Sample_Name and Sample_Group. # For QC workflow (raw IDAT files): also include Basename column (IDAT path prefixes). # For direct analysis (QC already done): Basename is not needed. meta <- LoadMeta("meta.tsv")  # Option A1: platform unknown — detect first meta <- check_platform(meta) meta_epic <- meta[meta$Platform == "EPIC", ] qcset <- runMethQC(meta_epic)  # platform auto-resolved from meta$Platform  # Option A2: platform known — pass directly # qcset <- runMethQC(meta, platform = "EPIC")  export(qcset, outdir = "qc_output", format = c("xlsx", "rds")) # xlsx: two workbooks for organized reporting: #   1. qc_table_main.xlsx — metadata (+ Platform, Final.QC), QC_matrix, Ctrl_matrix, statistics #   2. qc_table_extra.xlsx — QC_metrics (thresholds), contamination, recall_rate, predUniqDonor_ID # rds: Full MethQcSet object for programmatic access  # QC visualizations p_bar  <- plot(qcset, type = "qc_bar")                          # PASS/FAIL bar p_int  <- plot(qcset, type = "intensity",  icutoff = 11)        # intensity scatter p_dp   <- plot(qcset, type = "detection_pval", pcutoff = 0.05)  # avg det p-val p_cov  <- plot(qcset, type = "probe_coverage")                  # % probes detected p_sex  <- plot(qcset, type = "predicted_sex")                   # predicted sex p_ctrl <- plot(qcset, type = "ctrl_metrics")                    # control-probe metrics plot(qcset, type = "ctrl_metrics_detail",                       # per-metric detail PDFs      outFile = "qc_ctrl_matrix_detail")  # EPICv2 only: aggregate replicate probes before conversion (required step) # as.ImprintomeSet() will error if this is skipped for EPICv2 data. if (qcset@platform == "EPICv2") {   qcset <- aggregate_probes(qcset) }  # Keep only PASS samples before conversion qcset_pass <- subsetMethQC(qcset, final_qc = "PASS")  # Convert the QC-clean MethQcSet to ImprintomeSet probesets <- readRDS(system.file("extdata", "probesets_hg38.rds", package = "imprintomeR")) x <- as.ImprintomeSet(   qcset_pass,   probeset = probesets[["selected"]],   genome = "hg38" ) # If you already have QC-cleaned data, skip MethQcSet # Note: Basename column is not needed since QC step is skipped. meta <- LoadMeta("meta.tsv")  # Only needs Sample_Name and Sample_Group beta <- LoadBeta("cleaned_beta.tsv")  x <- ImprintomeSet(   beta = beta,   meta = meta,   probeset = probesets[["selected"]],   genome = "hg38",   assay = "EPICv1" ) library(imprintomeR) #>  #> Attaching package: 'imprintomeR' #> The following object is masked from 'package:base': #>  #>     beta  # The bundled example: beta values of the selected panel for 28 samples of GEO GSE52576 beta <- imprintome_example("beta")   # 782 probes x 28 samples, GEO GSE52576 (450K) meta <- imprintome_example("meta")   # Sample_Name, Sample_Group, title, health_state, gender probesets <- readRDS(system.file("extdata", "probesets_hg38.rds", package = "imprintomeR")) x <- ImprintomeSet(   beta = beta,   meta = meta,   probeset = probesets[["selected"]],   genome = "hg38",   assay = "450K" )  # Run analysis on one or more probesets x <- runImprintome(x, probeset = "selected", ids_cutoff = 0.2) #>  #>  [meta dim: 28 x 5 ] #>  [beta dim: 782 x 29 ] #>  [meta dim: 28 x 5 ] #>  [beta dim: 782 x 28 ] #>  [SubsetBeta] subset by probeset [query: 782; matched probes: 782 ] x <- runImprintome(x, probeset = "NanoImprint", ids_cutoff = 0.2,                    result_name = "AnalyzeImprintStatus.NanoImprint") #>  #>  [meta dim: 28 x 5 ] #>  [beta dim: 782 x 29 ] #>  [meta dim: 28 x 5 ] #>  [beta dim: 782 x 28 ] #>  [SubsetBeta] subset by probeset [query: 325; matched probes: 325 ]  names(results(x)) #> [1] "AnalyzeImprintStatus.selected"    "AnalyzeImprintStatus.NanoImprint" beta_x <- beta(x) meta_x <- meta(x) res_x <- results(x)[["AnalyzeImprintStatus.selected"]]

title: Visualization
text: auto - smart dispatch polar - IDS vs Angle scatter colored samples; colours follow sorted group names (group keeps colour across plots), groups named “control” “normal” grey drawn top, long legend labels wrap, radial axis extends beyond 0.8 needed (PlotPolar() exported saved result tables) mirror_density - maternal/paternal methylation density distributions beeswarm - cohort probe methylation sample beeswarm_origin - origin-split beeswarm (maternal/paternal probes) beeswarm_chr - chromosome-faceted beeswarm (single sample) violin - methylation distribution sample (violin plots) heatmap_by_probe - Heatmap_by_probe (probes × samples Illumina probe IDs) heatmap_by_gene - gene-level aggregated heatmap (genes aggregated Closest_TSS_gene_name) circular_heatmap - circular heatmap grouped sections (probes × samples arranged circle sample groups); vector PDF default, raster PNG (outFile ending .png, format = "png", res = 300) large cohorts cor_heatmap - sample--sample correlation heatmap rainfall - chromosomal rainfall plot probe-level IDI (single sample) radar - radar plot ICR-level deviation (single sample): one spoke per curated ICR (median IDI probes), genomic order clockwise top, labelled chromosome_annotated parental origin_ICR icr_heatmap - per-ICR heatmap (samples × ICRs) per-ICR calls; size follows numbers samples ICRs, sample names hidden 300 samples (show_sample_names), file format follows extension (.pdf, .png, .jpg); needs runImprintome(icr = TRUE) (see Per-ICR scores) ImprintomeSet plots take plot_type =; MethQcSet QC plots (Step 1) take type =. Plots coloured parental origin use probeset’s ORIGIN annotation, states parental allele methylated ICR; legend titled “Annotated parental origin”. colours annotations, allele-specific measurements.

3) Mirror density (maternal/paternal distributions) p_mirror <- plot(   x,   plot_type = "mirror_density",   probeset = "selected",   outFile = "plot_mirror_density.pdf" )  # 4) Beeswarm (cohort probe methylation) p_beeswarm <- plot(   x,   plot_type = "beeswarm",   probeset = "selected",   outFile = "plot_beeswarm.pdf" )  # 5) Beeswarm by origin (maternal/paternal probes) p_bee_origin <- plot(   x,   plot_type = "beeswarm_origin",   probeset = "selected",   outFile = "plot_beeswarm_origin.pdf" )  # 6) Beeswarm by chromosome (single sample) sample_id1 <- colnames(beta(x))[1] p_bee_chr <- plot(   x,   plot_type = "beeswarm_chr",   probeset = "selected",   sample_id = sample_id1,   chr = "chr11",   outFile = paste0("plot_beeswarm_chr_", sample_id1, ".pdf") )  # or "plot_circular_heatmap.png" for a raster image )  # 11) Correlation heatmap (sample-to-sample) cor_mat <- plot(   x,   plot_type = "cor_heatmap",   probeset = "selected",   SAMPLEID = "Sample_Name",   prefix = "plot" )  # title: Quality control and preprocessing (MethQcSet)
text: RAW data: meta.tsv must tab-delimited file least Sample_Name Sample_Group columns. QC workflow (Option — raw IDAT files): also include Basename column (full path prefix IDAT files). direct analysis (Option B — QC already done externally): Basename needed; just Sample_Name Sample_Group suffice. Additional columns (e.g., sex, diagnosis) carried available plotting. Basename must full path prefix IDAT files, .e. path without _Red.idat / _Grn.idat. QC pass criteria. sample Final.QC = "PASS" hold: least 95% probes detected p < pcutoff (default 0.05, .e. pctDetectedCpG_dP0.05 >= 95; set runMethQC(..., pcutoff = 0.01) run_meth_QC.R --pcutoff 0.01; detection p-values minfi::detectionP()); CtrlMetrics.QC PASS, means Bisulfite Conversion Green Red control-probe metrics least 1. control probes read, criterion 1 applies. control-probe metrics (Illumina BeadArray Controls Reporter), SNP genotype calls, sample-swap check predicted donor IDs follow ewastools methods (Heiss Just, 2018, Clin Epigenetics 10:73) implemented imprintomeR; 450K, EPICv1 EPICv2 IDATs give values ewastools 1.8.2, needed. values reported review affect Final.QC: control metrics (staining, extension, hybridization, specificity ), median intensities, predicted sex, SNP contamination predicted donor IDs. subsetMethQC(qcset, final_qc = "PASS") keeps passing samples. Already QC-cleaned data? Skip Step 2 Option B construct ImprintomeSet directly beta + meta. Key MethQcSet features: Platform validation: Prevents mixing 450K, EPICv1 EPICv2 QC metrics: Detection p-values, intensity summaries (mMed/uMed/aveMed merged QC_matrix), probe coverage review PDFs outdir: {prefix}_QC_detection_pval.pdf, {prefix}_QC_probe_coverage.pdf, {prefix}_QC_minfiDensity_all.pdf; report PDFs outdir/plots/: {prefix}_QC_intensity.pdf, {prefix}_QC_betaDensity_all/pass/fail.pdf, {prefix}_QC_minfiDensity_pass/fail.pdf. "noob" (default): minfi noob background dye-bias correction; "noob_swan": adds SWAN type /II adjustment (fixed seed, reproducible); "raw": unnormalized beta. QC_matrix — per-sample detection stats, intensity, predictedSex, Final.QC. Final.QC PASS least 95% probes detected p < pcutoff (default 0.05) , control-probe metrics available, CtrlMetrics.QC PASS.
